families.digest.none: Hash functions. Interchangeable only when they compute the same function (identical output).
families.keygen.none: Secret key generators. Interchangeable when they produce keys of the same algorithm and size that the consuming primitive accepts.
families.keypairgen.none: Key pair generators. Interchangeable when they produce keys of the same algorithm, size or curve that the consuming primitive accepts.

groups.description: AES secret key generation (KeyGenerator AES). Input: the caller supplies the key size in bits; no IV, digest or mode parameters. Key: application-held key material, not a provider-internal handle. Output: a freshly random AES secret key of the requested size, non-deterministic, raw key bytes. Consumer defines use (assumed).

AES KeyGenerator. Caller supplies only the key size in bits; no IV, digest or mode. Key: application-held, raw key bytes. Output: fresh random AES secret key of the requested size, non-deterministic, with exportable key material.
Code-made group by signature, no model decided it: function=SHA-256; its members are that function from each provider, at any key size.

RSA key pair generation (KeyPairGenerator with RSA). Caller supplies the modulus size and public exponent; the provider generates the key pair. Output: a new RSA public/private key pair of the requested size, randomized, not reproducible from inputs. Key contract not stated; the key is generated by the provider's RSA routine.
